name: Webform Datahub module
description: Webform handler plugin that POSTs mapped submission values to an external Datahub registration REST API.
project_description: Provides a Webform handler plugin (id webform_datahub) that, on each submission, authenticates against an external "Datahub" REST API with a stored username/password to obtain an access token, builds a nested AttendeeRegistration JSON payload from the webform-to-field mapping plus UTM query parameters, and POSTs it to the Datahub /api/attendee/registration endpoint. A site-wide settings form stores the endpoint base URI and credentials, and an optional hook records UTM parameters against submissions when a 'utm' entity type is present. Endpoint and credentials are administrator-configured, not request-supplied.
